Katar is exclusive to Swiftblade; dagger is shared with Ranger.
Acolyte is hybrid damage+support: Light resource, Radiant/Lantern stances, ultimate Borrowed Second.

Base classes Knight, Ranger, Arcanist, Acolyte; specs at Ch I / Ch III (Guardian/Vanguard->Runic Knight; Sniper/Beastwarden->Windstrider; Elementalist/Spellbinder->Astral Sage; Priest/Oracle->Dawnkeeper).
Six race prologues (time-wound / small job / invitation line).
Race hook threads: motive, resolve chapter, keepsake.
Short-stamped birth token (lean year).
Volunteers' Road examples: early bell, unfinished hammer, empty stone seat.
Warden membership never gates main story, dungeons, markets or combat progression.

decisions.text: Expansion II seeds (see Write Atlas Storyline).

Server stays on rapier2d; terrain height is a value that follows the ground. No combat outcome depends on height (no jump dodge, arcing shots, flying bosses). Bridges and multi-level areas are separate layers with portals; caves and dungeons are separate instances.
Target simulation tick is 30 Hz. Code is still 20 Hz (WORLD_TICK_RATE_HZ in server-rs/src/content/world_model.rs, tick_rate_ms in server-rs/src/main.rs); changing it is a separate feature.
Walkable slope limit is 35 degrees on both server and client; steeper is a cliff wall that slides movement along the contour.

Player persistence uses only the built-in Rust meta engine (RustMetaEngine + SqliteMetaStore). Nakama is removed. Cleanup order: client MetaGateway moves to the Rust meta HTTP API; delete the server Nakama path and its tests; delete nakama/, k8s nakama and cockroachdb files, docker-compose entries and the Nakama CI gate; update docs.
